# Strix QR by StrixDevs (strix-devs)
> 100% Free Lifetime QR Code Generator & Scanner Suite for North American and Global Businesses

## About Strix QR
Strix QR is a modern, privacy-first web utility built by StrixDevs (serving clients in Chicago, New York, Canada, and worldwide). It was built to solve predatory subscription traps where users are forced into $35/month recurring subscriptions after 14 days when their QR codes deactivate.

## Key Features & Guarantees
- **Never Expires**: Encodes data directly into the QR matrix (Static QR) with no middleman server.
- **Permanent Validity**: 6 months, 1 year, or lifetime — all 100% free with zero expiration risk.
- **In-Browser Camera Scanner**: Decode QR codes instantly using your device webcam/camera or file upload with zero server uploads.
- **Print-Shop Ready**: Vector SVG, PDF, and high-DPI PNG exports with automatic Reed-Solomon Error Correction Level H (30% redundancy).
- **Custom Designs**: Dot styles, corner eyes, color gradients, and center company logo insertion with auto-safe margin guards.
- **Supported Data Formats**: URLs, WiFi auto-connect (WPA/WPA2/WPA3), vCard digital business cards, WhatsApp direct messages, SMS, Email, Crypto payments (BTC/ETH/SOL), and plain text.
